caption_L1: This is a bar diagram labeled Most common items on takeaway or delivery kids ' menus in the United States between May 2013 and May 2014. There is a categorical scale starting with Burgers and ending with Spaghetti along the y-axis, marked Response. There is a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.4 on the x-axis, marked Share of kids' menus item is featured on.
caption_L2L3: Chicken fingers heavily outweigh the share of common kid delivery / takeaway items with a whopping share of almost 0.4 of the market. Burgers follow at around 0.33 and pizza comes in at around 0.28. The food items with lower market share include french fries (0.12), hot dogs (0.13) and quesadillas (0.14).
